messages:
Morgan: Quick pre-oncall note — I'm taking the 18:00 PT slot tonight. Leaving a short checklist, please skim and call out anything I missed. Will do handoff at 17:45.

Sam: Thanks — posting quick ack. I'll validate pager + runbook now.

Alex: FYI the GitOps deploy key was rotated this morning; service account token is fine but double-check the `oncall-deploy` secret. Command I used: `kubectl -n infra get secret oncall-deploy -o yaml` and look for `annotations: rotatedBy`.

Riley: VPN cert renewed yesterday, but openswan configs on macOS needed a manual trust step. If someone sees VPN failure, try: `sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/redwood-vpn.crt`.

Sam: Pager check done — I can see my PD test notification. If you want to test your routing: trigger a test from the runbook page (link below) -> select "test routing". Don't trigger a full page unless you mean it :grimacing:.

Morgan: Great. Runbooks and key items: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/quickstart (edited — public link blocked). Important points in that doc: how to escalate to infra SRE, where to find fallback model variants, and how to fall back to read-only mode for the admin console.

DevExBot: Reminder — service token expiring for `optimizer-worker` in 4 days. Recommend rotating before tomorrow's run. Use the rotation play in the runbook.

Alex: Also check your local `kubectl` contexts before you start: `kubectl config get-contexts` — make sure `redwood-prod` is not selected by accident. We had a near-miss last month.

Morgan: Adding quick commands I use during the first 5 minutes of shift:
```
# verify pager identity
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/v1/oncall/whoami

# quick infra health (token required)
curl -sS https://ops.internal/health | jq .services | grep -E "runtime|router|kvcache"
```

Sam: Small ask: can you confirm SSH jump key is present? `ls -l ~/.ssh/oncall_*` should show `oncall_2025` or similar. If missing, ping infra-keys channel.

Riley: For logging and tracing: Grafana dashboard "Oncall Overview" has a template variable for region. Set region to `us-west-2` for my coverage, otherwise you'll see a lot of noise.

Morgan: One risk note — the S3 token for our model artifacts has a short expiry window because of a bug in the rotation lambda. If you need to redeploy a model, check `artifacts-manager` logs for 401s; fallback is to request a temp link from infra.

Sam: I'll stay available until 18:15 to help with any access hiccups. After that @Riley will be the immediate backup.

oncall-bot: :bell: Scheduled on-call handoff reminder: Morgan -> Riley at 17:45 PT. If there is no manual acknowledge, the bot will ping on both channels at 17:50.

Morgan: Thanks all. If nothing else, I'll post a short handoff at 17:46 with the final state and any open items.

Riley: Copy — will do final ack and test a traceroute to `runtime-gateway` at handoff.

Sam: All green from me. :thumbsup:

Morgan: Hand-off complete (17:46 PT): state=green, open=artifact-token rotation, actions=monitor artifact logs, rotate optimizer token if flagged. Have a good slot, @Riley!
